source_specific_conventions.locators: Keep physical W1:NNN IDs separate from printed labels ①-N; section citations may share a physical page only within this batch owner and must name the source region and destination heading.
source_specific_conventions.page_ownership: JPG-W1-C002 owns every included physical page W1:024-W1:031 exactly once; there are no excluded pages in this batch.
source_specific_conventions.content: Designated JPGs are authoritative. Preserve question statements, importance, past-exam provenance labels, true/false verdicts, legal references, explanations, conditions and distinctions. Normalize checkbox and bold typography without dropping learner content.
source_specific_conventions.question_layout: Keep every question with its corresponding answer and explanation in the same section chunk. Keep false propositions explicitly labelled as 誤り and retain the correction/reason. Preserve additional-check markers and source-history tags when they carry source context.
source_specific_conventions.format: Source Markdown contains no bold, Cloze, Front/Back, integration or card output. Only layout decoration was normalized; the pilot correction restored omitted provenance/additional-check labels.
